name: agy-review
description: Code review of your local git changes by Google Antigravity (agy), with read-only repo access and no permission prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only code review of your git changes by Antigravity.
interface.longDescription: Hands the current git repository to the Antigravity CLI (agy), which reads the code itself with read-only access and returns a graded review. Runs without permission prompts; a guard hook blocks writes, deletes, installs and network access.
defaultPrompt: Ask Antigravity to review this branch against main.
Check that my Antigravity review setup is safe.
